answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in hollow, expire in lantern, and fable lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 158 aliases hence needs 147 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4975 identities would post 1375 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
